content: Unlike  today ,  she  thought, pulling her coat tighter   to keep out  the cold autumn air .   “The oath is the bond between the monarchy and the  people .   I t  is the trust that is placed into the hands of men and women .   T o stand up against the evil in this world   and   ensure the victims get the justice they  deserve . ”  “ Crandon , when  we take  the oath, we  agree to not get married  or have children. We agree to make justice our partner in life ,  and that is not for everyone, but I will tell you there is no higher calling .   B ut that does not mean you give up sex . ”  She shot  a smile at the apprentice as his face   turned red .   “ Y es ,  Warden , ” he  whispered but  refused  to meet her eyes.  They continued to ride for a while,  They came to an open field and nodding to herself Corliss turned to the young man. “ Crandon , have  you practiced much with your  SenPai , aside from the initial  training?”  T he young man’s face lit up.  Every apprentice relished the moment they were able to learn to use the SenPai. She suppressed a smile as the young apprentice answered  with  excitement edging  into  his voice .  “Not  really, Warden,” he said, reaching up and exposing the long leather bracer that was strapped to his left arm.  Corliss looked over to see the worn leather tied firmly to his  forearm  and  smiled as the sunlight danced over the multicolored runes that had been carved from crystal and inlaid into the leather .   T he young man ran his fingers over them,  and  the runes  began   to glow  as he summoned the power within them.  “Slow down  there ,   Crandon , let’s go over what you know before we start  using it . ”  T he young man  pushed   the sleeve back down to cover the magical bracer.   “So, what do you know about the  SenPai ,  Apprentice ?” Corliss asked.  Crandon   rolled his eyes .  “The SenPai was commissioned by the first  e mperor  for the warden s .   I t was crafted by the first members of the Order of the Dragon after signing the  Agreement , ” he  recited ,  as dry as if it were directly quoted from the textbook.  Time to throw him off a bit .  “Okay, how is it  warden s can use  m agic? Are we  m ages?” “ No. Wardens are not  m ages ,  nor do we wield  m agic .   T hat is the realm of the Mage and the Order .   H owever ,  like everyone ,  we all descend from those with power ,  so we have the ability to draw on  that  power ,  to a minor degree .   B ut we do not have the ability to actually use it .   T hat is where the Senpai  comes in , ” he stated ,  almost bored.   “ Okay, then how does the SenPai work?” she asked watching as the question caught him off guard .  Corliss could see his mind working .   I t was not an easy question —w ardens did not know the finer points of  m agic or  r unic script .   S o, she waited patiently as  Crandon  struggled to form an answer.  He started and then stopped  again ,  forming his thoughts .   “The SenPai is a set of runic spells  that  a w arden  can activate ,  giving them abilities such as increased hearing and sight .   Or they can  activate  the  s pirit  b ond . ”   A triumphant smile crept across his face as he waited for her to respond. “ Well done. And w hat is the spirit bond,  Crandon ?” Corliss  asked.   Crandon’s smile faltered a little as his eyes moved back and forth, she could see his mind forming words from pieces of lessons over the past year, then with a nod he spoke .  “We are able to identify with a creature .   S omething that  mirror s  our own values and strengths .   T hat animal is amplified and made real  through the  senpai’s spell , giving the Warden a friend in combat and a scout in tracking , ” he  offered,  and his smile grew  again . Corliss  conceded  the young man had learned well.
